title: US slaps import ban on Canadian alcohol and other goods
english: President Donald Trump has ordered a ban on various Canadian imports, including vehicles, dairy, and alcohol, starting late September. This move follows Canada's decision to place retaliatory tariffs on American goods in response to previous US taxes on Canadian products. While both nations acknowledge that these trade conflicts carry economic consequences, there are currently no new negotiations planned to resolve the dispute.

Tarkaanfiin kun kan fudhatame, Kanaadaan oomishoota Ameerikaa irratti gibira kaffaltii ramaddii duraan ture irratti deebii kennuuf jecha gibira dabalataa erga keessee booda. title: 'Constantly on my mind' - 9/11 agony goes on for bereaved, 25 years on
english: Twenty-five years after the September 11 attacks, families of the victims are still struggling to find closure as the trial for the alleged mastermind, Khalid Sheikh Mohammed, has yet to begin. Despite long and slow legal proceedings at Guantanamo Bay, a trial date has finally been set for 2028. Many grieving relatives worry that this date is too far away and that they may not live to see the justice they have been waiting for.
amharic: የሴፕቴምበር 11 ጥቃት ከተፈጸመ ሃያ አምስት ዓመታት ያለፉ ቢሆንም፣ የጥቃቱ አቀናባሪ ተብሎ የሚጠረጠረው ካሊድ ሼክ መሐመድ ክስ ገና ባለመጀመሩ የተጎጂ ቤተሰቦች ፍትሕ ለማግኘት አሁንም በመጠባበቅ ላይ ናቸው። በጓንታናሞ ቤይ ለረጅም ጊዜ ሲካሄድ የቆየው የቅድመ-ፍርድ ሂደት አድካሚ ቢሆንም፣ በመጨረሻ ለ2028 ዓ.ም የፍርድ ቀን ተቆርጧል። ይሁን እንጂ ብዙዎቹ የሟች ቤተሰቦች ይህ ጊዜ በጣም የራቀ በመሆኑ፣ የፍትሕ ሂደቱን ለማየት በሕይወት የመቆየታቸው ጉዳይ አሳስቧቸዋል።
oromo: Hojiin shororkeessummaa guyyaa 11 Sadaasaa raawwatame waggaa 25 kan lakkoofsiise ta'us, nama ijoo qindeessite jedhamtu Khalid Sheikh Mohammed irratti himannaan seeraa ammayyuu waan hin jalqabneef maatiin miidhamtootaa haqni akka hin argamne yaaddoo qabu. Giddu galeessa waraanaa Guantanamo Bay keessatti adeemsi seeraa baay'ee suuta waan deemef, guyyaan murtii bara 2028 gaafa ga'u ibsameera. Maatiin miidhamtootaa hedduun garuu guyyaan kun baay'ee fagaachuu isaa fi hamma yeroo sanaatti haqni akka kennamu arguuf lubbuun jiraachuu dhiisuu malu jedhanii yaaddoo guddaa qabu.

title: Anti-AfD protesters rally in Cologne after far-right election win
english: Thousands of demonstrators gathered in Cologne to express their opposition to the far-right Alternative for Germany (AfD) party. This protest was organized following the party's significant success in the recent state election in Saxony-Anhalt, where they secured nearly 44 percent of the vote. The march highlights growing public concern regarding the political rise of the AfD in the country.
amharic: በኮሎኝ ከተማ በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎች የአልተርናቲቭ ፎር ጀርመን (AfD) ፓርቲን በመቃወም ሰላማዊ ሰልፍ አድርገዋል። ይህ ተቃውሞ የተካሄደው ፓርቲው በሳክሶኒ-አንሃልት የክልል ምርጫ ወደ 44 በመቶ የሚጠጋ ድምጽ በማግኘቱ ነው። ሰልፉ የዚህን የቀኝ ዘመም ፓርቲ የፖለቲካ ተጽዕኖ በመቃወም ህዝቡ ያለውን ስጋት የሚያሳይ ነው።
oromo: Magaalaa Koloonyitti namoonni kumaatamaan lakkaa'aman paartii mirga-duree AfD mormuun hiriira bahaniiru. Hiriirri kun kan qophaa'e erga paartiin kun filannoo naannoo Saaksanii-Anhaalt irratti sagalee kutaalee 44 ol argatee booda dha. Hiriirri kunis guddina siyaasaa paartii kanaa irratti mormii fi yaaddoo uummataa kan calaqqisu dha.

title: Marco Rubio says US seeks more economic and security ties in Latin America
english: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio is visiting Colombia, Ecuador, and Peru to strengthen economic and security partnerships with key regional allies. The Trump administration aims to finalize new trade agreements while increasing military cooperation to counter China's expanding influence in Latin America. This diplomatic tour highlights a broader strategic push to reassert American interests across the Western Hemisphere.

Daawwannaan kun Ameerikaan naannoo gara dhihaatti dhiibbaa fi faayidaa ishee deebisnee mirkaneeffachuuf kan karoorfattedha.

title: US destroys five Iranian tankers, Iran retaliates with attacks on Jordan
english: The United States military destroyed five Iranian oil tankers following two consecutive missile attacks by Iran on an American warship. In retaliation for these strikes, Iran launched ballistic missiles at the Al Azraq base in Jordan, though Jordanian air defenses intercepted nearly all of them. These hostilities have further intensified regional tensions, leading to increased global oil prices and threats of additional strikes on ships in the Gulf.

oromo: Humnootni waraana Ameerikaa dooniiwwan boba'aa Iraan shan erga weeraraan booda, Iraan gamashee murtii haaloo bahuuf jechuun buufata waraana Ameerikaa kan Al-Azraq kan biyya Yordaanos keessatti argamu irratti misaa'elaan haleelteetti. title: Suspected smugglers on trial over deadliest migrant tragedy in France
english: A trial has started in Paris for 14 individuals accused of smuggling migrants in connection with a 2021 disaster in the English Channel that killed 31 people. Prosecutors claim the suspects used an overcrowded, unsafe boat that capsized while attempting to reach the UK. The victims, who came from several different countries, drowned after officials reportedly failed to respond effectively to multiple distress signals.

oromo: Hojiin seeraa namoota 14 irratti banamee jira; namoonni kunis bara 2021 galaana Ingilizitti godaantota 31 lubbuu dabarsan jedhamanii himataman. title: Iran war live: US hits Iranian tankers, IRGC attacks US base in Jordan
english: Tensions between the US and Iran have escalated significantly following a military confrontation. After Iran's Revolutionary Guard launched missile attacks against a US naval vessel, the American military retaliated by destroying five Iranian oil tankers. In response to this destruction, Iranian forces targeted a military base in Jordan that houses American personnel.

oromo: Waraanni fi walitti bu'iinsi gidduu Ameerikaa fi Iraan jiru erga rukuttaa missileen Iraan doonii waraana Ameerikaa irratti gaggeeffamee booda hamilee guddaa argateera. title: Jordan says its air defences struck down 18 of 20 missiles from Iran
english: Jordanian military officials reported that their air defense systems successfully intercepted 18 out of 20 Iranian ballistic missiles fired toward the country. The remaining two missiles landed in empty regions, resulting in no injuries or damage. Authorities are continuing to monitor the situation closely to ensure regional security.
amharic: የጆርዳን ወታደራዊ ኃይሎች የአገሪቱ የአየር መከላከያ ስርዓት ከኢራን የተተኮሱ 20 የባሊስቲክ ሚሳኤሎችን በመጥለፍ 18ቱን ማክሸፉን አስታውቀዋል። ቀሪዎቹ ሁለት ሚሳኤሎች ሰው በማይኖርባቸው አካባቢዎች ላይ በመውደቃቸው ምንም አይነት ጉዳት አላደረሱም። ባለስልጣናቱ የደህንነት ሁኔታውን በቅርበት እየተከታተሉ መሆኑን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Humni waraanaa Yordaanos akka ibsetti, sirni ittisa qilleensaa biyyattii xiyyaawwan ballistikii 20 Iran irraa dhukaafaman keessaa 18 bakka bu'anii fashalsiisuu danda'eera. Xiyyaawwan hafan lamaan namni hin jiraanne keessatti waan kufuuf miidhaan gahu hin jiru. Aangeyyoonni haala nagaa biyyattii xiyyeeffannoon hordofaa jiru.

title: Iran's IRGC say they attacked US base in Jordan
english: The Iranian Revolutionary Guard Corps claimed responsibility for a ballistic missile strike against a U.S. military facility located in Al Azraq, Jordan. Iran stated that this military action was carried out in response to recent American strikes on Iranian oil tankers. Authorities in Jordan have not yet verified or commented on the alleged attack.
amharic: የኢራን እስላማዊ አብዮታዊ ዘበኛ ኃይል በዮርዳኖስ አል አዝራቅ በሚገኝ የአሜሪካ ወታደራዊ ጣቢያ ላይ በባለስቲክ ሚሳኤል ጥቃት መፈጸሙን አስታውቋል። ኢራን ይህን እርምጃ የወሰደችው በአሜሪካ በአይራን የነዳጅ መርከቦች ላይ ለተፈጸመው ጥቃት የበቀል እርምጃ መሆኑን ገልጻለች። የዮርዳኖስ መንግስት እስካሁን ስለ ጥቃቱ የሰጠው ይፋዊ መግለጫ የለም።
oromo: Humnooniin Eegduu Warraaqsa Islaamaa kan Iraan, buufata waraana Ameerikaa kan Al-Azraaq, Jordaanitti argamu irratti xiyyaara kombiiluu (ballistic missile) fayyadamuun haleellaa raawwachuu isaanii beeksisaniiru. Iraan tarkaanfiin kun kan fudhatame, Ameerikaan dooniiwwan boba'aa Iraan irratti haleellaa raawwattee turteef deebii kennuuf akka ta'e ibsiteetti. Mootummaan Jordaanii hanga ammaatti haleellaa kana ilaalchisee mirkaneeffannaa ykn ibsa kennu hin qabu.

title: Paul Adams: British-Israeli relations at lowest ebb in decades
english: Diplomatic relations between Britain and Israel have reached a historic low following the UK's decision to ban trade with Israeli settlements in the West Bank. This policy shift aligns with the International Court of Justice's ruling that the occupation is unlawful, leading Britain to restrict certain goods and business activities linked to these settlements. In retaliation, Israel has taken aggressive measures, such as closing the UK consulate in East Jerusalem and removing British representatives from Gaza relief efforts.

oromo: Hariiroon dippiloomaasii biyyoota Ingilizii fi Israa'el gidduu jiru, mootummaan Ingilizii daldala naannoo weeraraa West Baankii keessatti gaggeeffamu dhorkuu isaa hordofee sadarkaa gadi aanaa irra ga'eera. Murteen kun kan fudhatame mana murtii addunyaa iratti akkaataa weerarichi seeraan alaa ta'e ibsamuu isaa hordofee dha. Israa'el tarkaanfii Ingilizii kanaan aaruun, qonsilaa Ingilizii kan magaalaa Yerusaalem keessa jiru cufuudhaan akkasumas bakka buutota Ingilizii hojii gargaarsa Gaazaa keessaa ari'uudhaan haaloo ba'atteetti.

title: Protesters, police clash in Albania over Trump-linked project
english: Protesters in Tirana clashed with police as they demonstrated against a controversial luxury resort project linked to the family of U.S. President Donald Trump. Demonstrators are concerned that the construction, located in a protected coastal nature reserve, will permanently destroy local wildlife habitats and restrict public access to the shore. The protest movement, which has persisted for over 100 days, has now evolved into a significant political challenge against Prime Minister Edi Rama’s government.
amharic: በአልባኒያ ዋና ከተማ ቲራና፣ ከአሜሪካው ፕሬዚዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ቤተሰብ ጋር የተያያዘ የቅንጦት ሪዞርት ግንባታን በመቃወም ተቃዋሚዎች ከፖሊስ ጋር ግጭት ውስጥ ገብተዋል። ተቃዋሚዎቹ ፕሮጀክቱ በተፈጥሮ ጥበቃ ቦታ ላይ በመገንባቱ የአካባቢውን የዱር እንስሳት መኖሪያ እንደሚያጠፋ እና የህዝብ የባህር ዳርቻ ተጠቃሚነትን እንደሚገድብ በመግለጽ ተቃውሟቸውን እየገለጹ ነው። ከ100 ቀናት በላይ የዘለቀው ይህ እንቅስቃሴ በአሁኑ ወቅት በጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ኤዲ ራማ መንግስት ላይ ትልቅ የፖለቲካ ተግዳሮት ሆኗል።
oromo: Magaalaa Tiranaa keessatti, namoonni mormii dhageessisan pirojektii hoteela gurguddaa maatii pirezidaantii Ameerikaa Doonald Traamp waliin walqabatu mormuun poolisoota waliin walitti bu'aniiru. Mormitootni kun iddoo qulqulluu qarqara galaanaatti ijaaramaa jiru kun bosona fi bineeldota naannichaa akka miidhu akkasumas fayyadamummaa uummataas akka daangessu ibsuun mormaa jiru. Guyyoota 100 ol kan itti fufe mormiin kun amma mootummaa ministira muummee Edii Raamaa irratti dhiibbaa siyaasaa cimaa uumee jira.

title: Haaland to the double as Manchester City beat Porto in Champions League
english: Erling Haaland scored two goals to lead Manchester City to a 2-0 victory against Porto in their opening Champions League match. Despite strong resistance from Porto's goalkeeper, Haaland broke the deadlock early in the second half and added a second goal during stoppage time. This win marks a successful start for new manager Enzo Maresca, while also cementing Haaland's legacy as he became the club's third-highest all-time scorer.
amharic: ኤርሊንግ ሃላንድ ሁለት ግቦችን በማስቆጠር ማንችስተር ሲቲ በቻምፒየንስ ሊግ መክፈቻ ጨዋታ በፖርቶ ላይ 2 ለ 0 ድል እንዲቀዳጅ አስችሎታል። የፖርቶ ግብ ጠባቂ ጥሩ እንቅስቃሴ ቢያሳይም፣ ሃላንድ በሁለተኛው አጋማሽ መጀመሪያ ላይ ግብ በማስቆጠር ውጤቱን ቀይሯል። ይህ ድል አዲሱ አሰልጣኝ ኤንዞ ማሬስካ በጥሩ ሁኔታ መጀመራቸውን የሚያሳይ ሲሆን፣ ሃላንድም በክለቡ ታሪክ ሦስተኛው ከፍተኛ ግብ አስቆጣሪ መሆን ችሏል።
oromo: Erling Haaland goolii lama lakkoofsiisee Manchester Cityn tapha Champions League jalqabaa irratti Porto 2-0 akka injifatu taasiseera. Eegduun goolii Porto carraawwan hedduu ofirraa qolatus, Haaland walakkaa lammaffaa irratti goolii jalqabaa kan galche yoo ta'u, goolii lammaffaan immoo yeroo dabalataa irratti galcheera. Injifannoon kun leenjisaa haaraa Enzo Marescaaf jalqaba gaarii kan ta'e yoo ta'u, Haaland ammoo goolii galchuun seenaa kilabichaa keessatti sadarkaa sadaffaa irratti argamuu danda'eera.

title: What the UK ban on goods from illegal Israeli settlements really means
english: The United Kingdom, alongside France and Canada, has introduced a ban on products originating from illegal Israeli settlements in the occupied West Bank. In response to this decision, the Israeli government has declared the closure of the British Consulate located in East Jerusalem. This move highlights growing international friction regarding the legal status of these settlements.
amharic: የእንግሊዝ፣ የፈረንሳይ እና የካናዳ መንግስታት በተያዘው የዌስት ባንክ ግዛት ውስጥ በሚገኙ ህገ-ወጥ የኢስራኤል ሰፈራዎች የሚመረቱ ምርቶችን እንዳይገቡ እገዳ ጥለዋል። ኢስራኤል ለዚህ ውሳኔ በሰጠችው ምላሽ በምስራቅ እየሩሳሌም የሚገኘውን የእንግሊዝ ቆንስላ እንደምትዘጋ አስታውቃለች። ይህ ክስተት በእነዚህ ሰፈራዎች ህጋዊነት ዙሪያ በአለም አቀፍ ደረጃ እየጨመረ የመጣውን አለመግባባት ያሳያል።
oromo: Mootummoonni UK, Faransaayi fi Kanaadaa, lafa daangeffame West Baank keessatti buufataalee Israa'el seeraan alaa ta'an keessaa oomishawwan dhufan irratti dhorkaa kaa'aniiru. Israa'el murtii kana mormuudhaan, quunxulaa (consulate) UK magaalaa Yerusaalem bahaa keessa jiru akka cufu beeksifteetti. Tarkaanfiin kun haala qubataalee kanaa ilaalchisee waldhabdee idil-addunyaa dabalaa jiru kan agarsiisuudha.

title: US warns Ford over ties with Chinese firms amid tensions
english: The US Department of Transportation has officially warned Ford Motor Company regarding its business partnerships with Chinese firms like CATL, Geely, and BYD. US officials argue that these collaborations create national security risks and undermine domestic supply chain independence. Following the public release of this critical letter, Ford's stock value dropped by over four percent.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የትራንስፖርት መምሪያ እንደ ሲኤቲኤል (CATL)፣ ጂሊ (Geely) እና ቢዋይዲ (BYD) ካሉ የቻይና ኩባንያዎች ጋር ስላለው የንግድ ግንኙነት የፎርድ ሞተር ኩባንያን አስጠንቅቋል። የአሜሪካ ባለስልጣናት እነዚህ አጋርነቶች ለሀገር ደህንነት ስጋት እንደሚፈጥሩ እና የአሜሪካን የኢኮኖሚ ነፃነት እንደሚጎዱ ይከራከራሉ። ይህ ማስጠንቀቂያ ይፋ ከተደረገ በኋላ የፎርድ የአክሲዮን ዋጋ ከስድስት በመቶ በላይ ቀንሷል።
oromo: Mootummaan Ameerikaa dhaabbata konkolaataa Ford waliin walitti dhufeenya inni dhaabbata Chaayinaa kanneen akka CATL, Geely fi BYD waliin qabu irratti akeekkachiisa dabarseera. Hojjettoonni mootummaa Ameerikaa tumsi kun nageenya biyyaa fi walitti dhufeenya gabaa Ameerikaa kan miidhu ta'uu ibsaniiru. Akeekkachiisni kun erga ifa ta'ee booda, gatiin aksiyoona Ford %4 ol gadi bu'eera.

title: Real Madrid beat Inter Milan as Mbappe goal sets Mourinho’s men on way
english: Real Madrid achieved a 2-1 victory over Inter Milan in their Champions League opener under manager Jose Mourinho. Kylian Mbappe and Fede Valverde scored the decisive goals after taking advantage of mistakes by the Italian defense. Although Carlos Augusto scored for Inter in the second half, Madrid's goalkeeper Thibaut Courtois ensured the win with several important saves.
amharic: ሪያል ማድሪድ በአሰልጣኝ ጆዜ ሞሪንሆ መሪነት በሻምፒዮንስ ሊግ የመክፈቻ ጨዋታ ኢንተር ሚላንን 2 ለ 1 አሸንፏል። የኢንተር ሚላን የተከላካይ ክፍል ስህተቶችን በመጠቀም ኪሊያን ምባፔ እና ፈዴ ቫልቨርዴ የማሸነፊያ ግቦቹን አስቆጥረዋል። በሁለተኛው አጋማሽ ካርሎስ ኦገስት ለኢንተር ግብ አስቆጥሮ የነበረ ቢሆንም፣ የሪያል ማድሪድ ግብ ጠባቂ ቲቦ ኮርቱዋ ያደረጋቸው ወሳኝ ቅብብሎች ቡድኑን ድል እንዲቀዳጅ ረድተውታል።
oromo: Real Maadrid leenjisaa Jose Mourinho jalatti tapha Champions League jalqabaa irratti Inter Milan 2 fi 1n mo'ateera. Kylian Mbappe fi Fede Valverde dogoggora ittisa Inter Milan fayyadamudhaan goolii injifannoo argamsiisan. Walakkaa lammaffaa irratti Carlos Augusto Interif goolii tokko kan lakkoofsise ta'us, eegduun goolii Real Maadrid Thibaut Courtois oolchiinsa barbaachisaa gochuudhaan injifannoo isaanii mirkaneesseera.

title: Rubio says Iran will lose tankers if it tries to hit US Navy ships
english: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio has issued a stern warning that the US will sink Iranian oil tankers in retaliation for any hostile actions against American warships. This statement follows a recent incident where the US military destroyed five Iranian tankers after an attempt to target a Navy vessel. The administration remains committed to this aggressive defensive policy to protect its maritime fleet from ongoing threats.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር ማርኮ ሩቢዮ፣ ኢራን በአሜሪካ የጦር መርከቦች ላይ የምትፈጽመውን ጥቃት ከቀጠለች፣ አሜሪካ በምላሹ የኢራንን የነዳጅ መርከቦች እንደምትሰምጥ አስጠንቅቀዋል። ይህ ማስጠንቀቂያ የተሰጠው አሜሪካ ሰኞ ዕለት የጦር መርከቧን ለማጥቃት ሙከራ ካደረገችው የኢራን ቡድን ጋር በተያያዘ አምስት የነዳጅ መርከቦችን ካጠፋች በኋላ ነው። የአሜሪካ መንግስት የባህር ኃይሉን ለመከላከል ሲባል ይህንን ጥብቅ አቋም እንደሚከተል አስታውቋል።
oromo: Ministirri Dhimma Alaa Ameerikaa Maarko Rubiyo, Iraan dooniiwwan waraanaa Ameerikaa irratti haleellaa raawwachuuf yaaluu ishii yoo itti fufte, Ameerikaan dooniiwwan boba'aa Iraan akka barbadeessitu akeekkachiisaniiru. Akeekkachiisni kun kan dhufe, Ameerikaan dhiheenya kana doonii waraanaa ishii irratti haleellaa yaaliin erga raawwatamee booda dooniiwwan boba'aa Iraan shan barbadeessuu ishii hordofee dha. Mootummaan Ameerikaa humna galaana isaa eeguuf jecha tarkaanfii cimaa kana itti fufuuf murteesseera.

title: US military says it destroyed five Iranian oil tankers
english: The U.S. Central Command reported that it destroyed five Iranian oil tankers on Tuesday. This military action was taken in response to two separate ballistic missile attacks by Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps against a U.S. Navy vessel. Fortunately, the American warship managed to avoid the missiles, and no U.S. personnel sustained any injuries during the confrontations.

Dooniin waraana US haleellaa kana jalaa miliquu kan danda'e yoo ta'u, walitti bu'iinsa kanaan miidhaan namoota US irra ga'e tokkollee hin jiru.

title: Syria, Jordan intercept barrage of Iranian missiles
english: Syrian and Jordanian air defense systems successfully shot down multiple Iranian missiles as they traveled across the border region. Reports suggest this significant missile attack is a retaliation by Iran following recent military strikes by the United States. Authorities managed to intercept at least eight projectiles over Jordanian cities, marking a notable escalation in the ongoing regional tensions.

Haleellaan kun tarkaanfii waraana Ameerikaan fudhatte booda, Iraan haaloo ba'uuf kan raawwatamte ta'uun ibsameera. Magaalota Yordaanoos irraatti xiyyitoonni gurguddoon yoo xiqqaate saddeet kan kuffifaman yoo ta'u, kunis waraansa naannichaa caalaatti kan hammaate ta'uun hubatameera.

title: Thirty more US troops wounded in Iran war, Pentagon database reports
english: The Pentagon recently reported that 30 additional American soldiers have sustained injuries during the ongoing conflict with Iran. This update raises the total casualty count to 820 wounded and 18 fatalities. These figures represent the cumulative impact of the hostilities that commenced on February 28.

oromo: Gabaasni Pentagon akka ibsetti, waraana Iran waliin gaggeeffamaa jiruun waraanni Ameerikaa 30 ta'an madaa'aniiru. Walumaagalatti, waraana kana keessatti waraanni 820 madaa'anii 18 immoo du'aniiru. Miidhaan kun waraanni kun Gurraandhala 28 erga jalqabee as kan ga'e dha.

title: South Korea says Hormuz talks with France concern contribution options, not troop deployment
english: South Korean President Lee Jae Myung clarified that recent discussions with French leadership regarding the Strait of Hormuz focus on non-military contributions to maritime security. The presidential office emphasized that these talks do not involve sending troops to the region. Officials also noted that this decision is independent of trade negotiations with the United States and addressed concerns raised by Iran.

oromo: Pirezidaantiin Kooriyaa Kibbaa Lee Jae Myung mariin Faransaay waliin dhimma Handhuura Hormuz irratti taasifame, waraana erguu osoo hin taane nageenya galaanaarratti gumaacha gosa biraa gochuu irratti kan xiyyeeffate ta'uu ibsaniiru. Waajjirri pirezidaantichaas biyyattiin gara naannichatti waraana erguuf karoorri akka hin qabne beeksiseera. Haaluma kanaan, tarkiinni kun daldala Ameerikaa waliin qaban irraa bilisa ta'uu fi yaaddoo Iraan kaastee tureefis deebii kennaniiru.

title: UK announces sanctions on West Bank settlements prompting furious Israeli response
english: The UK, along with France and Canada, has imposed sanctions on illegal Israeli settlements in the West Bank, citing concerns over violence and the forced displacement of Palestinians. British Foreign Secretary David Miliband accused some Israeli officials of ignoring or enabling these actions, which he described as ethnic cleansing. In response, Israel strongly rejected these allegations and threatened to close the UK's consulate in East Jerusalem as a countermeasure.

title: Philippine defence chief calls out China over note handed to him mid-panel
english: Philippine Defence Secretary Gilberto Teodoro has publicly condemned China for using intimidating tactics following a diplomatic incident at a forum in Seoul. During the event, a Chinese military official delivered a note to Teodoro that formally dismissed a 2016 international court ruling against Beijing's expansive maritime claims. Teodoro characterized this action as an act of aggression and bullying meant to pressure his nation regarding its sovereign rights in the South China Sea.

title: Does the UK have a legal obligation to redress the harms of slavery?
english: Jamaica and other nations are increasingly demanding that the United Kingdom pay reparations for its historical role in the transatlantic slave trade. This movement is gaining international support, with a United Nations committee recently suggesting that governments have a legal duty to address these past wrongs. While global powers remain divided on the issue, Caribbean and African leaders are actively developing formal strategies to seek debt relief and justice for the descendants of enslaved people.

title: China and Qatar are strengthening bilateral ties: What that really means
english: China and Qatar have agreed to deepen their strategic partnership, focusing on expanding cooperation in energy, technology, and investment. A key motivation for this strengthened relationship is the shared goal of stabilizing the Middle East amid ongoing regional conflicts. Both nations are especially concerned about protecting energy shipments through the Strait of Hormuz, which is vital for their economic interests.

title: Trump, Putin hold ‘frank’ phone call as US restarts Ukraine deal efforts
english: President Donald Trump and Vladimir Putin recently held a direct phone call to discuss potential strategies for ending the war in Ukraine. This conversation follows recent visits by U.S. envoys to both Russia and Ukraine to explore new peace proposals. While both sides noted the discussion was constructive, there has been no immediate breakthrough in the conflict.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ እና ቭላድሚር ፑቲን በዩክሬን ያለውን ጦርነት ለማቆም በሚቻልባቸው መንገዶች ዙሪያ በስልክ ተወያይተዋል። ውይይቱ የተካሄደው የአሜሪካ ልዩ ልዑካን በሩሲያ እና በዩክሬን ጉብኝት አድርገው አዳዲስ የሰላም ሃሳቦችን ካቀረቡ በኋላ ነው። ምንም እንኳን ሁለቱ ወገኖች ንግግራቸውን ገንቢ እንደሆነ ቢገልጹም፣ እስካሁን ድረስ በጦርነቱ ላይ የተገኘ ተጨባጭ መፍትሄ የለም።

Mariin kun kan ta'e ergamtootni Ameerikaa biyyoota lamaan keessatti argamuun yaada nageenyaa haaraa dhiyeessanii booda. Gammachuu qabaachuu isaanii ibsanillee, mariin kun hanga ammaatti furmaata qabatamaa waraana kanaaf fiduu hin dandeenye.

title: Qatar responds to Netanyahu’s ‘hostile state’ remark
english: Qatar has officially rejected recent statements made by Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, who characterized the nation as a hostile state. Qatari officials condemned these remarks, describing them as an intentional effort to damage their country's reputation. This diplomatic friction follows ongoing regional tensions involving Israel's military actions.

oromo: Qatar ibsa ministirri mummee Israa'el Benyamin Netanyaahu biyyattii 'biyya diinaa' jechuun kenne fudhatama dhabsiisteetti. Qondaalonni Qatar ibsa kana mormuun, yaalii maqaa biyyattii xureessuuf godhame jechuun himatanii jiru. Walitti buutiin dippilomaasii kun kan uumame, gocha waraana Israa'el waliin walqabatee naannichatti dhiphinnii dabalaa dhufuun isaa hubatameera.

title: 'We share the goal of stability': Rubio remarks restrained as western allies sanction Israel
english: The United Kingdom, France, and Canada have imposed new sanctions on Israeli settlements and restricted arms licenses, officially labeling the occupation of the West Bank as illegal. While US Secretary of State Marco Rubio acknowledged the decision, he stated that the United States will not participate in these punitive measures. Washington continues to prioritize regional stability and remains focused on managing tensions in the West Bank rather than joining its allies in these specific actions.
amharic: ዩናይትድ ኪንግደም፣ ፈረንሳይ እና ካናዳ በእስራኤል ሰፈራዎች ላይ አዲስ ማዕቀብ የጣሉ ሲሆን በምዕራብ ባንክ የሚደረገውን ወረራ በይፋ ሕገ-ወጥ ብለውታል። የአሜሪካ የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር ማርኮ ሩቢዮ ውሳኔውን እንደሚያውቁት ቢገልጹም፣ አሜሪካ በእነዚህ ማዕቀቦች እንደማትሳተፍ አስታውቀዋል። ዋሽንግተን በቀጠናው መረጋጋትን ቅድሚያ በመስጠት፣ አጋሮቿ ከወሰዱት እርምጃ ይልቅ በምዕራብ ባንክ ያለውን ውጥረት ለመቆጣጠር ላይ ትኩረት አድርጋ ትቀጥላለች።
oromo: Biyoonni Ingiliz, Faransaay fi Kaanaadaan qubata Israa'el irratti ergaa haaraa kan irra kaa'an yoo ta'u, qabannaa seeraan alaa ta'e kan Lixaa Baankiinis ifatti beekamtii kennaniiru. Ministirri Dhimma Alaa Ameerikaa Maarkoo Ruubiyoon murtee kana akka beekan ibsanis, Ameerikaan tarkaanfiiwwan kana keessatti hirmaachuu akka hin barbaadne dubbataniiru. Waashingitan naannichatti tasgabbii uumuu irratti xiyyeeffachuun, tarkaanfiiwwan kana irra, lixaa Baankiitti miira waldhabdee jiru tasgabbeessuu filatti.

title: EU urges Houthis to 'end all attacks' after strikes on Saudi oil facilities
english: The European Union has formally demanded that Houthi rebels stop their aggressive actions following recent strikes on Saudi Arabian oil infrastructure. Officials stated that these violent acts threaten regional stability, violate global laws, and hinder ongoing peace initiatives in Yemen. The bloc further urged the group to halt all offensive operations, including those targeting international shipping lanes.
amharic: የአውሮፓ ህብረት በሳውዲ አረቢያ የነዳጅ ማጣሪያ ተቋማት ላይ ጥቃት ካደረሱ በኋላ የሁቲ አማጽያን ጥቃታቸውን በአስቸኳይ እንዲያቆሙ ጠይቋል። እነዚህ ድርጊቶች የክልሉን ሰላም አደጋ ላይ የሚጥሉ እና በየመን ሰላማዊ መፍትሄ ለማምጣት የሚደረገውን ጥረት የሚያደናቅፉ መሆናቸውን ህብረቱ ገልጿል። በተጨማሪም የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች በቀይ ባህር ውስጥ የሚንቀሳቀሱ የንግድ መርከቦችን ጨምሮ ማንኛውንም አይነት ጥቃት እንዲያቆሙ አሳስቧል።
oromo: Gamtaan Awurooppaa haleellaa qondaaltota Saudii fi bu'uuraalee misoomaa biyyattii irratti raawwatame balaaleffachuun, gareen Huutii haleellaa isaa hatattamaan akka dhaabu gaafateera. Gochi kun nageenya naannichaa kan booressuu fi carraaqqii nagaa Yaman keessatti taasifamaa jiru kan gufachiisu ta'uu ibsameera. Gamtaan sun gareen Huutii sun iddoo kamittuu haleellaa raawwachuu akka dhaabu, keessattuu markheewwan daldalaa galaana diimaa keessa jiran irratti tarkaanfii fudhachuu akka dhiisu gorseera.

title: Israeli air raids hit southern Lebanon as Lebanese army announces deployment to all non-occupied parts
english: Israeli warplanes and artillery have conducted multiple strikes across several towns in southern Lebanon. In response, the Lebanese army announced it has deployed forces to all non-occupied areas in the south to help stabilize the region. These military movements aim to secure the area and provide a sense of safety for the local population.
amharic: የእስራኤል የጦር አውሮፕላኖች እና የጦር መሳሪያዎች በደቡብ ሊባኖስ በሚገኙ በርካታ ከተሞች ላይ ተከታታይ ጥቃቶችን ፈጽመዋል። ለዚህ ምላሽ የሊባኖስ ጦር በአገሪቱ ደቡባዊ ክፍል በእስራኤል ቁጥጥር ስር ባልሆኑ አካባቢዎች ሁሉ ወታደሮቹን ማስፈሩን አስታውቋል። ይህ እንቅስቃሴ አካባቢውን ለማረጋጋት እና ለነዋሪዎች ደህንነትን ለመስጠት ያለመ ነው።
oromo: Xiyyaaronni waraanaa fi meeshaaleen waraanaa Israa'el kutaa kibba Libaanoositti magaalota hedduu irratti haleellaa geggeessaniiru. kana hordofee, waraanni Libaanoos naannolee kibbaatti iddoo Israa'el harka hin galle hundatti waraana isaa qubachiisuu beeksiseera. Tarkaanfiin kun naannichatti tasgabbii uumuu fi jiraattotaaf nageenya mirkaneessuuf kan gargaaru dha.

title: Israeli settlements: What does the ICJ ruling require Britain and other states do?
english: The UK government has officially declared Israel's occupation of Palestinian territories unlawful, aligning itself with a 2024 International Court of Justice ruling. Foreign Secretary Ed Miliband announced new sanctions against Israeli settlements and a ban on arms exports that support the occupation. This move, supported by 11 other nations, aims to address concerns regarding the displacement of Palestinians and the expansion of illegal settlements.
amharic: የእንግሊዝ መንግስት የእስራኤል በፓለስቲና ግዛቶች ላይ ያለው ወረራ ህገ-ወጥ መሆኑን በይፋ አውጇል። የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትሩ ኤድ ሚሊባንድ በእስራኤል ሰፈራ ላይ ማዕቀብ መጣሉን እና ወረራውን የሚደግፉ የጦር መሳሪያዎች ወደ ውጭ እንዳይላኩ መከልከሉን አስታውቀዋል። ይህ ውሳኔ ከሌሎች 11 ሀገራት ድጋፍ የተገኘለት ሲሆን፣ አላማውም በፓለስቲናውያን ላይ እየደረሰ ያለውን መፈናቀል እና ህገ-ወጥ የሰፈራ መስፋፋትን ለመግታት ነው።
oromo: Mootummaan Biritish, qabsoon Israa'el naannolee Paalestaayinii irratti taasiftu seeraan alaa ta'uu ifatti labseera. Ministirri Dhimma Alaa Ed Miliband, buufataaleen Israa'el irratti tarkaanfiin diinagdee akka fudhatamuufi meeshaaleen waraanaa qabsoo kana gargaaran gara biyyaatti akka hin ergamne dubbataniiru. Tarkaanfiin kun biyyoota biraa 11 waliin ta'uun fudhatame, kaayyoon isaas buqqi'iinsa Paalestaayiniotaa fi babal'ina buufataalee seeraan alaa dhaabuudha.

title: UN welcomes countries' move to restrict trade with illegal Israeli settlements
english: The United Nations human rights office has praised a group of 12 nations, including Canada and several European countries, for moving to limit trade with illegal Israeli settlements. This decision received further support from Egypt, Jordan, and the Palestinian leadership, who view these actions as a necessary response to the growing crisis in the West Bank. UN officials emphasized that such concrete steps are vital given the current gravity of the situation in the region.
amharic: የተባበሩት መንግስታት የሰብአዊ መብቶች ቢሮ ካናዳን እና በርካታ የአውሮፓ አገራትን ጨምሮ በህገ-ወጥ የእስራኤል ሰፈራዎች ላይ የንግድ ገደቦችን የጣሉ 12 አገራትን ውሳኔ አድንቋል። ግብፅ፣ ዮርዳኖስ እና የፍልስጤም አስተዳደርም ይህንን እርምጃ በዌስት ባንክ እየተባባሰ የመጣውን ችግር ለመፍታት እንደ አስፈላጊ እርምጃ በመውሰድ ድጋፋቸውን ገልጸዋል። የተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅት ባለስልጣናት በክልሉ ያለውን አስቸኳይ ሁኔታ ግምት ውስጥ በማስገባት እንዲህ ያሉ ተግባራዊ እርምጃዎች ወሳኝ መሆናቸውን አስረድተዋል።
oromo: Waajjirri mirga namoomaa kan Dhaabbata Mootummoota Gamtoomani (UN), biyyoota 12 kan akka Kaanaadaa fi biyyoota Awurooppaa kanneen buufataalee Israa'el seeraan alaa ta'an waliin daldala murteessan galateeffateera. Ejjennoon kun gama biyyoota akka Gibxii, Yordaanos fi bulchiinsa Falasxeem irraa deggarsa argateera; isaanis tarkaanfiin kun haala naannoo Weest Baankii keessatti hammaataa jiruuf furmaata barbaachisaa dha jedhaniiru. Hoggantoonni UN akka jedhanitti, haala yeroo ammaa naannichatti jiru ilaalcha keessa galchuudhaan tarkaanfiileen akkasii baay'ee barbaachisoo dha.

title: Renoir paintings worth millions stolen in French museum heist
english: Thieves broke into the Renoir Museum in southern France and stole two valuable paintings, each estimated to be worth millions. Although the robbers initially grabbed four artworks, they dropped two of them in the museum gardens while fleeing from the police. Authorities believe the well-prepared suspects used professional tools to carry out the heist, which has once again raised concerns regarding art security in European museums.
amharic: በደቡባዊ ፈረንሳይ በሚገኝ የሬኖየር ሙዚየም ውስጥ ዘራፊዎች ሰብረው በመግባት እያንዳንዳቸው በሚሊዮን የሚቆጠር ዶላር የሚያወጡ ሁለት ሥዕሎችን ሰርቀዋል። ዘራፊዎቹ መጀመሪያ ላይ አራት ሥዕሎችን ቢወስዱም፣ ከፖሊስ ሲያመልጡ ሁለቱን በሙዚየሙ ግቢ ውስጥ ጥለዋቸው ሄደዋል። በደንብ የተዘጋጁት ወንጀለኞች ይህን ዘረፋ የፈጸሙት በሙያዊ መሳሪያዎች በመታገዝ ሲሆን፣ ይህም በአውሮፓ ሙዚየሞች ውስጥ ባለው የጥበብ ስራዎች ደህንነት ላይ ስጋት ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Hattuuwwan magaala guddoo Faransaay kibbaatti argamtu keessatti bakka kuusaa sanaa cabsatanii seenuun, tokkoon tokkoon isaanii miiliyoonaan lakkaa'amu qaban, fakkiiwwan bareedoo lama hatanii jiru. Hattuuwwan kunneen jalqaba irratti fakkiiwwan afur fudhatanii kan turan ta'us, yeroo poolisiin hordofamanitti isaan lama bakka kuusaa sanaa qarqara keessatti gadi dhiisanii badaniiru. Hattuuwwan kunneen meeshaalee ammayyaa fayyadamuun kan qophaa'an ta'uun isaanii kan himame yoo ta'u, gochi kun immoo qabeenyaa aadaa giddu-gala awurooppaa keessatti argamanii fi eegumsa isaanii irratti yaaddoo guddaa uumee jira.

title: British widow faces deportation from Sweden after 22 years
english: A 78-year-old British woman, Joyce Thomas, is at risk of being deported from Sweden despite living there for over two decades. She missed the deadline to apply for residency following Brexit, an administrative requirement she was unaware of until recently. She is currently awaiting a response to her legal appeals, expressing deep distress at the possibility of being separated from her family and her late husband’s grave.

title: Israeli strikes transform Lebanese city into ghost town
english: The southern Lebanese city of Nabatieh has become deserted after intense Israeli military strikes destroyed infrastructure and residential areas. Once a busy economic hub, the city is now largely empty as residents flee the escalating conflict. These repeated attacks have left the urban landscape devastated and the local economy paralyzed.

title: UK sanctions on Israeli settlements a ‘seismic’ shift says Albanese
english: The United Kingdom has imposed new sanctions on Israeli settlements in the occupied West Bank, noting that Palestinians are suffering from ethnic cleansing in the region. UN official Francesca Albanese described this policy change as a significant and historic move following a long period of British support for previous settlement activities. While the decision is viewed as a major turning point, advocates stress that it represents only an initial step toward addressing the ongoing crisis.

title: Israeli academia accused of systemic apartheid against Palestinians
english: A recent report by the rights group Adalah reveals that Israeli universities are systematically discriminating against Palestinian students through a biased disciplinary system. Since October 2023, numerous students have faced severe penalties, such as expulsion and suspension, for expressing cultural or religious sentiments on social media. The report highlights a two-tier process where Palestinian students are denied standard legal protections compared to their Jewish Israeli peers. Critics describe this institutional approach as a form of academic apartheid that suppresses Palestinian voices.

title: Maldives asks UK to reopen sovereignty talks over Chagos Islands
english: Maldivian President Mohamed Muizzu has requested that the UK government reopen negotiations regarding the sovereignty of the Chagos Islands. The Maldives claims the islands based on geographical proximity and historical ties, and is unhappy that they were not consulted before the UK initially agreed to transfer the territory to Mauritius. This dispute remains significant because the archipelago hosts a critical, long-term joint military base used by the UK and the US.

title: At least two people dead after Russian strikes on Kyiv
english: Russian drone strikes hit Kyiv early Tuesday, resulting in at least two deaths and ten injuries while damaging residential buildings. This attack follows a brief pause in strikes that coincided with high-level meetings between Ukrainian officials and envoys representing Donald Trump. Despite recent diplomatic discussions, the conflict continues to intensify as both sides trade drone attacks.

title: Liverpool announce five-year shirt sponsorship deal with Turkish Airlines
english: Liverpool Football Club has secured a major five-year sponsorship agreement with Turkish Airlines beginning in mid-2027. This contract, valued at over $405 million, will see the airline replace Standard Chartered as the team's primary shirt sponsor. The deal represents one of the most profitable partnerships in Premier League history and builds on the club's long-standing connection to Istanbul.
amharic: የሊቨርፑል እግር ኳስ ክለብ ከሰኔ 2027 ጀምሮ ለሚቀጥሉት አምስት ዓመታት የሚቆይ የቱርክ አየር መንገድን ዋና ስፖንሰር የሚያደርግ ስምምነት ተፈራርሟል። ከ405 ሚሊዮን ዶላር በላይ ዋጋ ያለው ይህ ስምምነት የሊቨርፑልን የረዥም ጊዜ ስፖንሰር ስታንዳርድ ቻርተርድን ይተካል። ይህ ስምምነት በፕሪሚየር ሊጉ ታሪክ ውስጥ ካሉ እጅግ ከፍተኛ ዋጋ ከሚሰጣቸው የንግድ ሽርክናዎች አንዱ ሆኖ ተመዝግቧል።
oromo: Kilabbiin kubbaa miillaa Liverpool waggoota shaniif kan turu waliigaltee ispoonsaraa Turkis Eerlayinsii waliin mallatteesseera. Waliigalteen kun kan jalqabu yoo ta'u, qarshii miiliyoona 405 ol kan baasuudha. Waliigaltee kanaan Turkis Eerlayinsii ispoonsaraa uffata kilabbichaa kan durii bakka bu'u yoo ta'u, kunis seenaa Pirimeer Liigichaa keessatti waliigaltee qarshii baay'ee argamsiisu keessaa tokko ta'a.

title: Qatar says reopening Strait of Hormuz ‘unconditionally’ is a priority
english: Qatar is actively leading diplomatic efforts to resolve the ongoing conflict between the United States and Iran, emphasizing the urgent need to reopen the Strait of Hormuz without conditions. During meetings with Chinese officials, Qatari representatives highlighted that the current instability is damaging to the entire region and requires political commitment from both sides. Additionally, Qatar expressed strong condemnation of recent Houthi attacks, which are currently disrupting international maritime trade and navigation in the Red Sea.
amharic: ኳታር በአሜሪካ እና በኢራን መካከል ያለውን ግጭት በዲፕሎማሲያዊ መንገድ ለመፍታት ጥረት እያደረገች ሲሆን፣ የሆርሙዝ የባህር መተላለፊያን ያለ ቅድመ ሁኔታ መክፈት ዋና ቅድሚያ እንደምትሰጠው አስታውቃለች። የኳታር ባለስልጣናት ከቻይና አቻዎቻቸው ጋር ባደረጉት ውይይት፣ አሁን ያለው አለመረጋጋት ለክልሉ አገራት ጎጂ በመሆኑ የሁለቱም ወገኖች የፖለቲካ ፍላጎት አስፈላጊ መሆኑን አጽንኦት ሰጥተዋል። ከዚህም በላይ ኳታር በቀይ ባህር ውስጥ የሚገኘውን ዓለም አቀፍ የባህር ትራንስፖርት እያስተጓጎሉ ያሉትን የሁቲዎች ጥቃት በጥብቅ አውግዛለች።
oromo: Qatar walitti bu'iinsa Ameerikaa fi Iraan gidduu jiru karaa dippiloomaasiitiin furuuf tattaaffii cimaa gochaa jirti; keessattuu daandii galaana Hormuz haala tokko malee banuun dhimma ariifachiisaa akka ta'e ibsiteetti. Bakka buutonni Qatar hoggantoota Chaayinaa waliin marii taasisaniin, tasgabbii dhabuun kun guutuu naannichaaf miidhaa waan qabuuf, gam lamaanuu fedhii siyaasaa agarsiisuun akka barbaachisu ibsaniiru. Kana malees, Qatar haleellaa gareen Huutii galaana diimaa keessatti daldala idil-addunyaa fi imala dooniiwwanii irratti raawwachaa jiran akka mormitu beeksisteetti.

title: UK announces sanctions on illegal Israeli settlements
english: The British government has announced new sanctions against illegal Israeli settlements in the West Bank, including a ban on importing goods produced in these areas. Foreign Secretary Ed Miliband stated that the UK can no longer remain passive regarding settlement expansion, which he claims undermines the two-state solution and involves the displacement of Palestinians. While the U.S. and some Israeli officials have criticized the decision, Britain maintains that the ongoing occupation is unlawful.
amharic: የብሪታንያ መንግስት በተያዘው የዌስት ባንክ ግዛት በሚገኙ ህገ-ወጥ የእስራኤል ሰፈራዎች ላይ አዳዲስ ማዕቀቦችን መጣሉን አስታውቋል። የሀገሪቱ የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር ኤድ ሚሊባንድ እንዳሉት ብሪታንያ ሰፈራዎችን ማስፋፋት የሁለት ሀገር መፍትሄን የሚያበላሽ እና ፍልስጤማውያንን የሚያፈናቅል ድርጊት በመሆኑ ዝም ብላ ልትመለከት አትችልም ብለዋል። ምንም እንኳን የአሜሪካ እና የአንዳንድ የእስራኤል ባለስልጣናት ውሳኔውን ቢቃወሙትም፣ ብሪታንያ በዌስት ባንክ ያለው ይዞታ ህገ-ወጥ እንደሆነ አቋሟን ገልጻለች።
oromo: Mootummaan Biritishii qe'ee Israa'el kan daangaa seeraan alaa ta'ee fi naannoo West Baankii jiran irratti tarkaanfii sanadaa haaraa fudhachuu ishee beeksisteerti. Ministirri Dhimma Alaa biyyattii Ed Miliband akka jedhanitti, babal'inni qe'ee kanaa furmaata biyya lamaa kan miidhuu fi falasxiinota kan buqqisu waan ta'eef, Biritishii cal'istee ilaaluu hin dandeessu. Murtii kana irratti Ameerikaa fi bakka bu'oonni Israa'el tokko tokko kan morman ta'us, Biritishii naannoo West Baankii keessatti qabachuu fi buufachuun kun seeraan alaa ta'uu isaa irraa duubatti hin jettu.

title: Sudan’s healthcare system on brink of collapse, MSF warns
english: Doctors Without Borders has warned that Sudan's medical system is near total failure because over one-third of its health facilities are currently closed. This crisis is fueled by a severe shortage of international funding and the ongoing conflict, which has left millions of people without essential care or food. The organization is urging global leaders to urgently increase financial support to prevent further collapse of these vital services.
amharic: የዶክተሮች ያለ ድንበር ድርጅት (MSF) የሱዳን የጤና ሥርዓት ከሶስት አንድ በላይ የሆኑ የህክምና ተቋማት በመዘጋታቸው ለከፍተኛ ውድቀት መቃረቡን አስጠንቅቋል። ይህ ቀውስ የተፈጠረው በአለም አቀፍ የገንዘብ ድጋፍ መቀነስ እና በጦርነቱ ምክንያት ሲሆን፣ በሚሊዮን የሚቆጠሩ ዜጎች መሰረታዊ የጤና እና የምግብ እርዳታ እንዳያገኙ አድርጓል። ድርጅቱ የአለም መሪዎች እነዚህን ወሳኝ አገልግሎቶች ለመታደግ አስቸኳይ የገንዘብ ድጋፍ እንዲያደርጉ ጥሪ አቅርቧል።
oromo: Dhaabbanni 'Doctors Without Borders' (MSF) akka jedhetti, buufataaleen fayyaa Sudaan keessa jiran keessaa harki sadii keessaa tokko cufamuu isaaniitiin sirni fayyaa biyyattii manca’uuf qarqara ga'eera. Rakkoon kun kan dhufe gargaarsi biyyoolessaa hir’achuu fi waraana ittifufaa jiruun namoota miliyoonaan lakkaa'aman tajaajila barbaachisaa fi nyaata dhabsiisuu isaatiin dha. Dhaabbatichi hoggantoonni addunyaa tajaajila kana oolchuuf gargaarsa maallaqaa ariifachiisaa akka taasisan gaafateera.

title: Canada braces for prolonged trade war as counter-tariffs on US take effect
english: Canada has officially started imposing retaliatory tariffs on billions of dollars of American goods, signaling a deepening trade conflict between the two neighbors. While both nations express a desire for an agreement, formal negotiations remain stalled with no signs of immediate resolution. The situation is further complicated by rising tensions and threats of additional trade restrictions from both sides.
amharic: ካናዳ በአሜሪካ ምርቶች ላይ የበቀል ቀረጥ መጣል የጀመረች ሲሆን ይህም በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል ያለውን የንግድ ውጥረት አባብሶታል። ሁለቱም ወገኖች ስምምነት ላይ ለመድረስ ፍላጎት እንዳላቸው ቢገልጹም፣ እስካሁን ድረስ ምንም አይነት ድርድር አልተጀመረም። በአሁኑ ወቅት በሁለቱ አገራት መካከል ያለው የንግድ ግንኙነት በይበልጥ እየተካረረ ይገኛል።
oromo: Kanaadaan meeshaalee Ameerikaa gara biyyaatti galan irratti gibira ramaduu jalqabdee jirti; kunis walitti bu'iinsa daldalaa biyyoota lamaan gidduu jiru kan hammeesse ta'eera. Biyyoonni lamaanuu waliigaltee irra gahuu akka barbaadan ibsanii jiranis, mariin mootummaa yeroodhaf dhaabbatee jira. Haalli kun walitti bu'iinsa siyaasaa fi soda gibira dabalataa gara fuulduraatti dhufuu danda'uun kan wal qabate dha.

title: Trial over alleged murders of Australian surfer brothers starts in Mexico
english: A trial has begun in Mexico for three men accused of murdering two Australian brothers and their American friend during a botched robbery in 2024. The victims disappeared while on a surfing trip in Baja California, and their bodies were later discovered in a well with gunshot wounds. Prosecutors are pushing for sentences exceeding 200 years for the suspects, while the victims' parents attended court to witness the proceedings and honor their sons' memories.
amharic: እ.ኤ.አ. በ2024 በሜክሲኮ በደረሰ የዘረፋ ሙከራ ሁለት አውስትራሊያዊ ወንድማማቾችን እና አንድ አሜሪካዊ ጓደኛቸውን በመግደል የተጠረጠሩ ሶስት ሰዎች የፍርድ ሂደት ተጀምሯል። ተጎጂዎቹ በባጃ ካሊፎርኒያ የሰርፊንግ ጉዞ ላይ እያሉ የጠፉ ሲሆን፣ በኋላም አስከሬናቸው በጥይት ተመትቶ በጉድጓድ ውስጥ ተገኝቷል። አቃቤ ህግ ለተጠርጣሪዎቹ ከ200 ዓመት በላይ እስራት እንዲቀጡ እየጠየቀ ሲሆን፣ የተጎጂዎቹ ወላጆች የልጆቻቸውን መታሰቢያ ለማክበር እና የፍርድ ሂደቱን ለመከታተል በፍርድ ቤቱ ተገኝተዋል።
oromo: Magaalaan Meeksikoo keessatti namoota sadii obboloota Awustiraaliyaa lamaa fi michuu isaanii Ameerikaa tokko bara 2024 hatummaa fashale irratti ajjeesan jedhamanii shakkaman irratti seeraan gaafachuu eegaltetti. Miidhamtoonni kunneen imala surfiingii (bishaaniin deemu) irratti utuu jiranii badanii, boodarras reeffi isaanii boolla keessatti xiyyaan rukutamanii argame. Abbaan alangaa namoota shakkaman kunneen waggaa 200 oliin akka hidhaman gaafachaa kan jiru yoo ta'u, maatiin miidhamtootaa garuu aadaa ijoollee isaanii kabajuufi adeemsa seeraa hordofuuf gara mana murtiitti dhiyaataniiru.

title: Houthi attacks on southern Saudi Arabia reportedly injure dozens
english: A series of Houthi militant strikes against southern Saudi Arabia has resulted in injuries to 73 civilians, including women and children. The attacks specifically targeted various civilian areas and economic infrastructure. This surge in violence coincides with an escalation of the ongoing conflict within Yemen.
amharic: በደቡባዊ ሳዑዲ አረቢያ በሁቲ ታጣቂዎች በተፈጸመ ተከታታይ ጥቃት 73 ንጹሃን ዜጎች፣ ሴቶችና ህጻናትን ጨምሮ ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል። ጥቃቶቹ የሲቪል መኖሪያዎችንና የኢኮኖሚ መሰረተ ልማቶችን ያነጣጠሩ ነበሩ። ይህ የጥቃት ማገርሸት በየመን እየተባባሰ ከመጣው ግጭት ጋር ተያይዞ የተከሰተ ነው።
oromo: Humni Houthi kibba Saudii Arabiyaatti haleellaa raawwateen dubartoota fi ijoollee dabalatee namoonni 73 miidhamaniiru. Haleellaan kun bakkeewwan sivilii fi iddoowwan dinagdee irratti kan xiyyeeffate ture. Guddinni haleellaa kanaa waraana Yemen keessatti hammaachaa jiru waliin kan wal qabatu dha.

title: As fuel prices rise again, Iran’s government urges citizens to cut back
english: The Iranian government has increased gasoline prices for citizens who consume more than 110 litres per month, doubling the cost for high usage. Officials are urging the public to reduce fuel consumption to address economic strain caused by sanctions and declining oil production. This move reflects the government's struggle to maintain expensive subsidies while facing a significant energy crisis.
amharic: የኢራን መንግስት በወር ከ110 ሊትር በላይ ነዳጅ ለሚጠቀሙ ዜጎች የነዳጅ ዋጋን በእጥፍ ጨምሯል። ባለስልጣናት በኢኮኖሚ ቀውስ እና በነዳጅ ምርት መቀነስ ምክንያት ህዝቡ የነዳጅ ፍጆታቸውን እንዲቀንሱ እያሳሰቡ ነው። ይህ ውሳኔ መንግስት በኢኮኖሚ ማዕቀቦች እና በኃይል አቅርቦት እጥረት መካከል ውድ የሆነውን የነዳጅ ድጎማ ለመቆጣጠር የሚያደርገውን ጥረት ያሳያል።
oromo: Mootummaan Iraan namoota ji’atti liitira 110 oli fayyadaman irratti gatii boba’aa dachaan dabarseera. Hoji-gaggeessitoonni mootummaa rakkoo diinagdee fi hir’ina oomisha boba’aa irraa kan ka’e ummanni fayyadama boba’aa akka hir’isu gorsaa jiru. Tarkaanfiin kun mootummaan kaffaltii gargaarsa boba’aa (subsidy) fi rakkoo damee anniisaa to’achuuf qabsoo godhu agarsiisa.

title: Indonesia airports reopen after volcanic ash disrupts thousands of flights
english: Indonesian authorities have reopened five airports, including Jakarta's main hub, following a closure caused by volcanic ash from Mount Anak Krakatau. The disruption, which stemmed from a major eruption on Saturday, forced the cancellation of nearly 3,000 flights and impacted hundreds of thousands of passengers. Officials are currently inspecting aircraft and facilities to ensure safety, warning that it will take some time for normal flight schedules to fully resume.

oromo: Magaalaa Azilaal kan biyya Morookoo keessatti roobni cimaan roobee, lolaa tasaa hamaan uumameera. Lolaan kunis mana jireenyaa, suuqiiwwanii fi daandiiwwan magaalattii keessa dhangala'uun miidhaa guddaa geessiseera. Namoonni naannichaa balaa roobni cimaan kun geessise hordofee miidhaan irra ga'e jiraachuu ibsameera.

title: Canada’s retaliatory tariffs on $20bn of US goods take effect
english: Canada has officially launched retaliatory tariffs on $20 billion worth of American products, ranging from 15 to 50 percent, in response to similar measures imposed by the US. This trade conflict impacts over 700 items, including steel, agricultural equipment, and household appliances. To assist local businesses and workers affected by these tensions, the Canadian government has introduced a multi-billion dollar support package.
amharic: ካናዳ በአሜሪካ የንግድ ማዕቀብ ላይ በምትወስደው የአጸፋ እርምጃ በ20 ቢሊዮን ዶላር የሚገመቱ የአሜሪካ ምርቶች ላይ ከ15 እስከ 50 በመቶ የሚደርስ ቀረጥ ጥላለች። ይህ የንግድ ውዝግብ ብረታ ብረትን፣ የግብርና መሳሪያዎችን እና የቤት እቃዎችን ጨምሮ ከ700 በላይ ምርቶችን ይነካል። ለዚህ ውዝግብ የተጋለጡ የካናዳ ስራ ፈጣሪዎችን እና ሰራተኞችን ለመደገፍ መንግስት የበርካታ ቢሊዮን ዶላር የድጋፍ ጥቅል ይፋ አድርጓል።
oromo: Kaanaadaan tarkaanfii haaloo ba'uu ittiin fudhatteen, meeshaalee Ameerikaa gatiin isaanii dolaara biliyoona 20 ta'u irratti gibira dhibbeentaa 15 hanga 50 ta'u kan keesse yoo ta'u, kunis tarkaanfii Ameerikaan fudhatte waliin wal qabata. Wal dhabdeen daldalaa kun sibiila, meeshaalee qonnaa fi meeshaalee mana keessaa dabalatee oomishalee 700 ol irratti dhiibbaa uumeera. Mootummaan Kaanaadaas miidhaa kana qolachuuf hojjettootaa fi dhaabbilee daldalaa biyyattii gargaaruuf qarshii biliyoonaan lakkaawwamu ramadeera.

title: Traffic in Hormuz Strait slows down on Monday, data shows
english: Shipping traffic through the Strait of Hormuz experienced a slight decline on Monday. Data indicates that only seven commodity vessels passed through the waterway, compared to eight the previous day. This busy passage remains a critical route for global trade.
amharic: በሆርሙዝ የባህር ወሽመጥ የሚያልፉ የንግድ መርከቦች ቁጥር ሰኞ ዕለት ትንሽ ቅናሽ አሳይቷል። መረጃዎች እንደሚያመለክቱት ሰኞ ዕለት ሰባት የጭነት መርከቦች ብቻ ሲያልፉ፣ ይህም ከቀድሞው ቀን ስምንት መርከቦች ጋር ሲነጻጸር ያነሰ ነው። ይህ የባህር መስመር ለዓለም አቀፍ ንግድ እጅግ አስፈላጊ ቦታ ነው።
oromo: Hanga markaba gabaa dhangala'aa fi meeshaalee garaa garaa qabatanii gara gargala Hormuz keessa darban guyyaa Wixataa dabre xiqqoo gad bu'eera. Odeeffannoon akka mul'isutti, guyyaa Wixataa markaboonni torba qofa darban; kunis guyyaa dura kan darban markaboota saddeet wajjin yoo madaalamu hir'ina qaba. Daandiin bishaanii kun daldala addunyaatiif iddoo baay'ee barbaachisaa ta'e dha.

title: Saudi-led coalition in Yemen says 73 people wounded in Houthi attacks, vows firm response
english: Over 70 people, including women and children, suffered injuries following a series of Houthi militant strikes on several Saudi Arabian cities. A coalition spokesperson condemned these attacks as a severe threat to public safety and national security. In response, the Saudi-led forces have promised to take decisive military action to neutralize future threats from the group.
amharic: በሳዑዲ አረቢያ ከተሞች በሁቲ ታጣቂዎች በተፈጸመ ጥቃት ከ70 በላይ የሚሆኑ ሴቶችና ህጻናትን ጨምሮ ሰዎች ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል። የጥምር ኃይሉ ቃል አቀባይ ጥቃቱ የህዝብን ደህንነት እና የአገር ሉዓላዊነት የጣሰ አደገኛ ድርጊት መሆኑን ገልጸዋል። ለዚህም ምላሽ ለመስጠት ጥምር ኃይሉ አስፈላጊውን ወታደራዊ እርምጃ እንደሚወስድ ቃል ገብቷል።
oromo: Humni Houthi magaalota Saudi Arabiyaa gara garaa irratti haleellaa raawwateen dubartoota fi daa'imman dabalatee namoonni 73 ol miidhamaniiru. Dubbi himaan waraana gamtaa Saudi Arabiyaa haleellaan kun nageenya uummata fi bilisummaa biyyaa irratti miidha guddaa akka qabu ibsaniiru. Kanaafis, gamtaan kun gara fuulduraatti haleellaa akkanaa ittisuuf tarkaanfii cimaa fudhachuuf waadaa galeera.

title: US representative threatens to bar UK businesses for upcoming Israeli settlement trade ban
english: Florida representative Randy Fine has warned that British companies could face a business ban in his state if the UK proceeds with its plan to restrict trade with Israeli settlements. Fine stated that Florida’s existing laws prohibit commercial dealings with any entity that boycotts Israel. He argued that the UK’s decision could result in significant financial losses for British firms that are currently major trading partners with Florida.
amharic: የፍሎሪዳው ተወካይ ራንዲ ፋይን፣ እንግሊዝ በእስራኤል ሰፈራዎች ላይ የንግድ እገዳ ለመጣል ካቀደች፣ በግዛታቸው የሚንቀሳቀሱ የብሪታንያ ኩባንያዎች ላይ እርምጃ እንደሚወስዱ አስጠነቀቁ። ፋይን እንዳሉት፣ እስራኤልን የሚቃወሙ ኩባንያዎች ከፍሎሪዳ መንግሥት ጋር ንግድ እንዳያደርጉ የሚከለክል ሕግ በግዛቱ አለ። ይህ የብሪታንያ ውሳኔ፣ ከፍሎሪዳ ጋር በንግድ ግንኙነት ላይ ላሉ የብሪታንያ ድርጅቶች ከፍተኛ የገንዘብ ኪሳራ ሊያስከትል እንደሚችልም ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Bakka bu'aan mootummaa Florida Randy Fine, yoo UK daldala naannoo Israa'elitti argamu irratti dhorkaa kaa'uu itti fufte, dhaabbileen UK mootummaa Florida keessatti daldaluu akka hin dandeenye akeekkachiisaniiru. Fine akka jedhanitti, seera Floridaatiin dhaabbileen Israa'el wajjin daldaluu didan kamiyyuu mootummaa naannichaa wajjin hojjechuu hin danda'an. Murtii UK kanaanis, dhaabbileen UK kanneen Florida wajjin daldaluu fi faayidaa guddaa argatan miidhaa dinagdee keessa seenuu danda'u.

title: Iran's acting defence minister says Tehran capable of targeting US warships
english: Iran's acting defense minister, Majid Ibn Reza, has publicly dismissed American assertions that Iran is unable to strike US naval vessels. He insisted that the Iranian military possesses the necessary technology to target these ships if required. His comments serve as a direct response to US claims regarding the naval blockade currently affecting Iranian ports.
amharic: የኢራን ጊዜያዊ የመከላከያ ሚኒስትር ማጂድ ኢብን ረዛ፣ አሜሪካ በኢራን የባህር ላይ ወደቦች ላይ የጣለችውን ማዕቀብ ለማስፈጸም የሚንቀሳቀሱ የአሜሪካ የጦር መርከቦችን የመምታት አቅም የላትም በሚል አሜሪካ የሰጠችውን አስተያየት ውድቅ አድርገዋል። ሚኒስትሩ የኢራን ወታደራዊ ኃይል እንደዚህ አይነት መርከቦችን የማጥቃት ቴክኖሎጂ እንዳለው በግልጽ ተናግረዋል። ይህ ምላሽ የተሰጠው አሜሪካ በኢራን ወታደራዊ አቅም ላይ የሰነዘረችውን ትችት ተከትሎ ነው።
oromo: Ministirri ittigaafatamaan ittisa biyyaa Iraan Maajid Ibni Rezaa, Ameerikaan dandeettii Iraan markaboota waraana Ameerikaa rukutuuf qabdu irratti shakkii kaaste kan qeeqan yoo ta'u, Iraan teeknoolojii kana akka qabdu ibsaniiru. Ministirichi ibsa kanaan, waraanni isaanii markaboota Ameerikaa kanneen buufataalee Iraanitti dhiheenyaan socho'an rukutuuf hamma qophii ta'an hubachiisaniiru. Yaanni kunis gabaasa Ameerikaan dandeettii waraana Iraan ilaalchisee baasteef deebii kan kennuu dha.

title: The UK sanctions should target activity 'supporting or maintaining' settlements, Tayab Ali says
english: The UK government is set to announce a ban on trade and investment involving illegal Israeli settlements to align with an International Court of Justice ruling. Human rights expert Tayab Ali argues that these sanctions must prohibit British citizens and businesses from engaging in any activities that sustain the occupation. This move aims to ensure the UK fulfills its legal obligations regarding the status of Palestinian territories.
amharic: የእንግሊዝ መንግሥት ከዓለም አቀፉ ፍርድ ቤት ውሳኔ ጋር በተጣጣመ መልኩ ሕገ-ወጥ ከሆኑ የእስራኤል ሰፈራዎች ጋር የሚደረግ ንግድና ኢንቨስትመንትን ለመከልከል ተዘጋጅቷል። የሰብአዊ መብት ባለሙያው ታያብ አሊ እንደሚሉት፣ እነዚህ ማዕቀቦች የብሪታኒያ ዜጎችና ኩባንያዎች ወረራውን የሚያግዝ ማንኛውንም ዓይነት እንቅስቃሴ እንዳያደርጉ ማገድ አለባቸው። ይህ እርምጃ የብሪታኒያን ዓለም አቀፍ ግዴታዎች ለመወጣት ያለመ ነው።
oromo: Mootummaan UK murtee Mana Murtii Addunyaa waliin wal simuuf jecha daldalaa fi invastimantii naannolee Israa'el seeraan alaa ta'an waliin godhamu dhorguuf qophaa'eera. Ogeessi mirga namoomaa Tayab Ali akka jedhanitti, sagantaan kun lammiileen British fi dhaabbileen daldalaa hojiiwwan qabsoo Israa'el gargaaran kamiyyuu akka hin raawwanne dhorkachuu qaba. Tarkaanfiin kun dirqama idil-addunyaa UK itti gaafatamummaa ishee bahuuf kan gargaaru dha.

title: Eiffel Tower shut by staff protest after women moved for religious visit
english: The Eiffel Tower was closed on Monday due to a staff strike protesting a recent incident where female employees were removed from their posts to accommodate a visiting Hindu religious group. Management admitted that allowing the group's request to limit interaction with women was a mistake that violated the company's commitment to gender equality. The workers launched the protest to express their humiliation and to demand that management ensures such discriminatory practices never happen again.

oromo: Hojjettoonni gamoo 'Eiffel Tower' guyyaa Dilbataa garee amantii Hindu tokko erga daawwatanii booda, hojjettoonni dubartoota ta'an bakka hojiirraa akka kaafaman taasifamuusaanii mormuun Wiixata darbe hojii dhaabanii turan. Bulchiinsi gamoosichaas, gaaffii garee sanaa fudhachuun dubartoota bakka buusuun dogoggoraafi mirga walqixxummaa saalaa kan cabsu ta'uu beeksisaniiru. Hojjettoonni kun miira gadadoo itti dhaga'ame ibsuufi haalli akkasii gara fuulduraatti akka hin deebine gaafachuuf mormii kana gaggeessaniiru.

title: Rubio heads to Ecuador, Colombia, Peru after right-wing victories in region
english: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio is visiting Colombia, Ecuador, and Peru to strengthen ties with newly elected leaders who share a right-wing political alignment with the Trump administration. This diplomatic mission aims to increase American influence in the region, focusing on security cooperation and a militarized strategy to combat drug cartels. The trip highlights a broader shift in Latin America, where the US is actively collaborating with like-minded governments to address shared security and economic interests.

english: Palestinian parents in the West Bank are deeply concerned for their children's safety as a rise in settler violence affects local schools. title: Oil prices surge as US-Iran strikes intensify in Strait of Hormuz
english: Global oil prices have jumped to nearly a six-week high following an escalation of military strikes between the United States and Iran in the Strait of Hormuz. This vital maritime route, which normally carries a significant portion of the world's oil, is seeing reduced traffic and supply concerns as both sides target tankers and facilities, including a recent strike on a Saudi refinery. Analysts warn that these ongoing conflicts are creating global supply shortages that continue to drive energy costs upward.

title: Indian temple collapses into Ganges as riverbank erodes
english: A historic temple built in 1954 in India's West Bengal state fell into the Ganges River due to severe soil erosion. The incident occurred after the river current damaged the protective walls surrounding the structure. This event has caused distress among local residents and sparked a debate regarding the safety of historical landmarks near riverbanks.

title: Israel’s removal of Gaza rubble risk to war crimes evidence: UN
english: The United Nations warns that Israel’s ongoing removal of rubble in Gaza threatens to destroy critical evidence of potential war crimes. UN Special Rapporteur Francesca Albanese stated that clearing this debris violates previous international court orders and prevents families from recovering the bodies of thousands of victims. Experts fear that this action is intentionally erasing historical proof of the conflict while hindering efforts to achieve justice for the Palestinian people.
amharic: የተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅት በእስራኤል በጋዛ እየተከናወነ ያለው የፍርስራሽ ማስወገድ ስራ የጦር ወንጀል ማስረጃዎችን ሊያጠፋ እንደሚችል አስጠንቅቋል። ልዩ ዘጋቢ ፍራንቸስካ አልባኒዝ እንደገለፁት ይህ ተግባር አለም አቀፍ የፍርድ ቤት ትዕዛዞችን የሚጥስ እና በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ የሟቾችን አስከሬን ለማግኘት የሚያደርጉትን ጥረት የሚያደናቅፍ ነው። ባለሙያዎች ይህ ድርጊት የጦርነቱን ማስረጃዎች ሆን ተብሎ በመደምሰስ ለተጎጂዎች ፍትህ እንዳይገኝ እያደረገ ነው ብለው ይሰጋሉ።
oromo: Tokkummaan Mootummootaa akka ibsetti, Israa'el gaza keessatti manca'iinsa manaa fi bu'uuraalee misoomaa suuqaa jirtu kun ragaalee yakka waraanaa balleessuu danda'a jedheera. Gabaasaa addaa kan ta'an Firaanchiskaa Albaaniiz akka jedhanitti, gochi kun ajaja mana murtii idil-addunyaa kan cabsuu fi maatiin namoota kumaatamaan lakkaawwaman reeffa jaallan isaanii akka hin arganne godhaa jira. Ogeeyyiin akka jedhanitti, gochi kun ragaalee waraana sanaa balleessee fi namoota miidhaan irra ga'eef haqa argamsiisuu kan gufachiisuudha.

title: Yemen fighting escalates as forces battle for Bab al-Mandeb Strait
english: Violent clashes have intensified in Yemen as government forces mount counterattacks against Houthi fighters near the Bab al-Mandeb Strait. The conflict has resulted in hundreds of deaths within a single day and caused thousands of local residents to abandon their homes. Fighting is currently focused heavily in the areas of Taiz and Hodeidah.
amharic: በየመን የባብ አል-ማንደብ የባህር በርን ለመቆጣጠር በሚደረገው ግጭት የመንግስት ሰራዊት እና የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች መካከል ውጊያው ተባብሷል። ባለፉት ሃያ አራት ሰዓታት ውስጥ በመቶዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎች የተገደሉ ሲሆን በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ነዋሪዎችም ከቀያቸው እንዲፈናቀሉ ተገደዋል። ግጭቱ በአሁኑ ወቅት በታይዝ እና በሆዴዳህ አካባቢዎች በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ እየተካሄደ ይገኛል።
oromo: Yemen keessatti waraanni Bab al-Mandeb to'achuuf godhamu hammaatee, loltoonni mootummaa fi gareen Huthis walitti bu'aa jiru. Guyyaa tokko keessatti namoonni dhibbaan lakkaa'aman ajjeefamuu fi kumaatamaan kan lakkaa'aman immoo mana isaanii gadi lakkisuuf dirqamaniiru. Waraanni kun yeroo ammaa magaalota Taiz fi Hodeidah keessatti daran hammaatee itti fufee jira.

title: Robots protest in Poland over AI regulation concerns
english: Approximately 30 robots gathered outside the Polish digital affairs ministry to participate in a demonstration. Organized by activists, this event aimed to highlight growing concerns regarding the impact of artificial intelligence on the labor market. The protesters are pushing for stricter regulations to address the potential for robots to displace human employees.
amharic: በፖላንድ የዲጂታል ጉዳዮች ሚኒስቴር ፊት ለፊት ወደ 30 የሚጠጉ ሮቦቶች የተቃውሞ ሰልፍ አድርገዋል። ይህ በዘመቻ አራማጆች የተዘጋጀው ክስተት፣ አርቲፊሻል ኢንተለጀንስ በሰው ኃይል ላይ ሊያመጣ ስለሚችለው ተጽዕኖ ውይይት እንዲኖር ለማድረግ ያለመ ነው። ተቃዋሚዎቹ ሮቦቶች የሰውን የሥራ ቦታ ሊተኩ ይችላሉ በሚል ስጋት፣ ለቴክኖሎጂው ጥብቅ ደንቦች እንዲወጡ እየጠየቁ ነው።
oromo: Polaand keessatti robotonni 30 ta’an ministeera dhimma dijitaalaa fuulduratti hiriira bahan. Duula kana kan qindeessan qaamonni, teknolojii arifishal intelejensii hojii irratti dhiibbaa akkamii akka qabaatu irratti mariin akka taasifamuufi. Hiriirtonni kun, robotonni namoota hojii irraa buqqisuu danda’u jedhanii waan sodaataniif, seeronni cimoo ta’an akka tumaman gaafachaa jiru.

title: Thousands turn out in Serbia for funeral of  'Butcher of Bosnia' Ratko Mladić
english: Thousands of people gathered in Belgrade for the funeral of Ratko Mladić, the former Bosnian Serb military leader convicted of genocide and war crimes. Mladić, who died while serving a life sentence for his role in the Srebrenica massacre, remains a polarizing figure viewed by many Serbs as a hero despite international condemnation. The European Union has strongly criticized the public honoring of a convicted war criminal, noting that such celebrations contradict fundamental European values.
amharic: በቦስኒያ የዘር ማጥፋት ወንጀል ፈጽመዋል ተብለው በተፈረደባቸው የቀድሞ የቦስኒያ ሰርብ ወታደራዊ መሪ ራትኮ ምላዲች የቀብር ሥነ ሥርዓት ላይ በቤልግሬድ በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎች ተገኝተዋል። ምላዲች በስሬብሬኒካ የዘር ማጥፋት ወንጀል እያገለገሉ ባለበት የዕድሜ ልክ እስራት በኔዘርላንድስ እስር ቤት በ84 ዓመታቸው ህይወታቸው አልፏል። ምንም እንኳን በዓለም አቀፍ ደረጃ በወንጀለኛነታቸው ቢታወቁም፣ በሰርቢያ ውስጥ ለብዙዎች የጀግንነት ምሳሌ ተደርገው ይታያሉ፤ የአውሮፓ ህብረት ግን ይህንን ክብር በጽኑ አውግዟል።
oromo: Namoonni kumaan lakka’aman magaala Belgraditti sirna awwaalcha Ratko Mladić, ajajaa waraana Serbota Bosniyaa kan ajjeechaa sanyii fi yakka waraanaatiin himatame irratti argamaniiru. Mladić kan du’e yeroo adabbii hidhaa umrii guutuu ajjeechaa Srebrenicaan walqabatee itti murame hordofee mana hidhaa Holandiitti ture. Namichi kun hawaasa idil-addunyaa biratti yakkamtoota waraanaa gurguddoo keessaa tokko kan ta’e yoo ta’u, biyya Serbiyatti garuu namoota hedduu biratti akka gootaatti ilaalama; ta’us Gamtaan Awurooppaa sirna awwaalcha isaa kabajaa fi jaalalaan raawwatamu cimsinee balaaleffateera.

title: The domestic armed threat facing Iran
english: Iranian authorities are increasingly worried about internal security threats from ethnic armed groups and anti-government cells, especially amid ongoing conflicts with the US and Israel. While officials often blame foreign-backed actors for domestic unrest, recent widespread protests have been driven primarily by economic hardship rather than a cohesive pro-monarchy movement. The government continues to arrest suspected dissidents to maintain control as public frustration with the current administration grows.
amharic: የኢራን ባለስልጣናት በአሁኑ ወቅት ከአሜሪካ እና ከእስራኤል ጋር ባለው ግጭት መሀል፣ በአገር ውስጥ በሚንቀሳቀሱ ታጣቂ ቡድኖች እና የጸረ-መንግስት ሴሎች ላይ ያላቸው ስጋት እየጨመረ መጥቷል። መንግስት አመጹን ከውጭ በሚደገፉ ሃይሎች ጋር ለማያያዝ ቢሞክርም፣ በቅርቡ የታዩት ተቃውሞዎች መሰረታዊ መንስኤ ከፖለቲካዊ የንጉሳዊ ስርአት ናፍቆት ይልቅ የኢኮኖሚ ቀውስ ነው። መንግስት ህዝባዊ ቅሬታን ለመቆጣጠር እና ስልጣኑን ለማስጠበቅ አጠራጣሪ ተቃዋሚዎችን ማሰሩን ተያይዞታል።
oromo: Mootummaan Iraan walitti buiinsa Ameerikaa fi Israa'el waliin qabdu keessatti, garee hidhattootaa fi qaamolee mootummaa mormuun nageenya biyyattii irratti sodaan guddaan akka jiru himameera. Mootummaan rakkoo biyya keessaa kana humnoota alaa irraa dhufanitti kan hidhu ta'us, mormiin yeroo dhihoo kun kan ka'e rakkoo diinagdee malee deeggarsa sirna moototaa duraaniitiin akka hin taane ibsameera. Mootummaan mormitoota to'achuuf jecha namoota shakkituu ta'an irratti tarkaanfii hidhaa fudhachuu itti fufeera.

title: Syria detains Assad-era general accused of bloody crackdown on protests
english: Syrian authorities have arrested former Major-General Mohammed Ali Durgham, a high-ranking official from the previous regime. He is accused of participating in the deadly 1982 Hama massacre and ordering soldiers to open fire on peaceful demonstrators in 2011. This arrest is part of an ongoing effort by the new government to hold former security officials accountable for their past crimes.
amharic: የሶሪያ ባለስልጣናት በቀድሞው መንግስት ከፍተኛ ወታደራዊ መኮንን የነበሩትን ሜጀር ጀነራል መሐመድ አሊ ዱርጋምን በቁጥጥር ስር አውለዋል። ግለሰቡ በ1982 በሐማ ከተማ በተፈጸመው ጭፍጨፋ እና በ2011 በሰላማዊ ሰልፈኞች ላይ የተኩስ ትዕዛዝ በመስጠት ተከሷል። ይህ እርምጃ አዲሱ የሶሪያ መንግስት በቀድሞው አገዛዝ ወቅት ግፍ የፈጸሙ የጸጥታ አካላትን ለፍርድ ለማቅረብ ከሚያደርገው ጥረት አንዱ አካል ነው።
oromo: Mootummaan Suuriyaa ajajaan waraanaa olaanaa bulchiinsa duraanii, Meejer Jeneraal Mohaammed Alii Durgaam jedhamu hidheera. Innis bara 1982 magaalaa Haamaa keessatti yakka suukkanneessaa raawwachuu fi bara 2011 hiriira nagaa irratti namoota ajjeesuuf ajaja kennuu irratti himatameera. Hidhaan kun mootummaan haaraan biyyattii qondaaltota bulchiinsa duraanii yakka raawwatan itti gaafatamummaatti dhiyeessuuf hojjechaa jiru keessaa isa tokko.

title: Trump threatens to block Canada’s Bombardier sales unless planes made in US
english: President Donald Trump has announced that Canadian aircraft manufacturer Bombardier will be prohibited from selling its planes in the United States unless the company moves its production facilities to American soil. Trump criticized Canada for unfair trade practices and asserted that the company relies too heavily on U.S. customers while allegedly blocking American businesses from operating in Canada. This move escalates existing trade tensions between the two nations and puts significant pressure on Bombardier, which generates over half of its revenue from the U.S. market.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ የካናዳው የአውሮፕላን አምራች ኩባንያ ቦምባርዲየር አውሮፕላኖቻቸውን በአሜሪካ ውስጥ ካላመረቱ በስተቀር ምርቶቻቸውን በአሜሪካ ገበያ መሸጥ እንደማይችሉ አስታውቀዋል። ትራምፕ ካናዳ በአሜሪካ ኩባንያዎች ላይ ኢ-ፍትሃዊ የንግድ እንቅፋቶችን እየፈጠረች ነው በማለት ከሰሱ። ይህ ውሳኔ በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል ያለውን የንግድ ውጥረት ያባባሰው ሲሆን፣ አብዛኛውን ገቢውን ከአሜሪካ የሚያገኘው ቦምባርዲየር ኩባንያ ላይ ከፍተኛ ጫና ይፈጥራል።
oromo: Pirezidaanti Doonaald Tiraamp, oomishaan xiyyaaraa Kaanaadaa kan ta'e 'Bombardier' yoo xiyyaara isaa biyya Ameerikaa keessatti oomishuuf walii gale malee gabaa Ameerikaa keessatti gurgurachuu akka hin dandeenye beeksisaniiru. Tiraamp Kaanaadaan hojii daldalaa irratti Ameerikaaf haqummaa hin qabdu jechuun komataniiru. Tarkaanfiin kun daldala biyyoota lamaan gidduu jiru kan dhiphise yoo ta'u, galii isaa gurguddaa Ameerikaa irraa kan argatu Bombardier irratti dhiibbaa cimaa uumeera.

title: Russia shutters German consulate as diplomatic freeze deepens
english: Russia has ordered the closure of the German consulate in St. Petersburg, requiring all staff to depart by September 18. This action is a direct retaliation against Germany, which recently shut down Russian diplomatic facilities following allegations of a drone sabotage plot. These events signify a major decline in diplomatic relations between Moscow and Berlin amid ongoing tensions regarding the war in Ukraine.
amharic: ሩሲያ በሴንት ፒተርስበርግ የሚገኘው የጀርመን ቆንስላ እንዲዘጋ ትእዛዝ የሰጠች ሲሆን ሁሉም ሰራተኞች መስከረም 8 እንዲወጡ አሳስባለች። ይህ እርምጃ የተወሰደው በድሮን ጥቃት ሙከራ ተጠርጥረው ጀርመን የሩሲያ ዲፕሎማቲክ ተቋማትን ከዘጋች በኋላ እንደ አጸፋዊ ምላሽ ነው። እነዚህ ድርጊቶች በዩክሬን ጦርነት ምክንያት በሞስኮ እና በበርሊን መካከል ያለው ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ግንኙነት እየተባባሰ መምጣቱን ያሳያሉ።
oromo: Raashiyaan konsilaa Jarmanii magaalaa Saint Petersburgitti argamu akka cufuuf ajajee fi hojjettoonni hundinuu guyyaa Fulbaana 8 dura akka bahaniif murteessiteetti. Tarkaanfiin kun kan fudhatame, Jarmaniin haleellaa xiyyaara maleeyyuun (drone) walqabatee dhaabbilee dippiloomaasii Raashiyaa erga cuftee booda akka deebii haaloo bahuutti fudhatameera. Taateewwan kun walitti bu'iinsa waraana Yuukireenii hordofee hariiroon dippiloomaasii biyyoota lamaanii hammaachaa akka jiru agarsiisu.

title: Israel’s plan to split the West Bank
english: Israel is implementing the E1 plan, which involves building an exclusive road between Jerusalem and the Ma’ale Adumim settlement. This project requires the demolition of Palestinian shops and will force approximately 4,000 residents from their homes. If completed, the initiative will effectively divide the West Bank, creating space for new settler housing.
amharic: እስራኤል በኢ1 (E1) ዕቅድ አማካኝነት በኢየሩሳሌምና በማአሌ አዱሚም ሰፈር መካከል ለራሷ ብቻ የሚያገለግል መንገድ እየገነባች ነው። ይህ ፕሮጀክት የፍልስጤማውያን ሱቆችን ማፍረስን የሚጠይቅ ሲሆን ወደ 4,000 የሚጠጉ ነዋሪዎችን ከመኖሪያቸው የሚያፈናቅል ነው። ይህ ዕቅድ ሲጠናቀቅ የምዕራብ ባንክን ለሁለት በመክፈል ለአዳዲስ ሰፋሪዎች መኖሪያ ግንባታ መንገድ ይከፍታል።
oromo: Israa'el karoora E1 jedhamuun, maallaqa ishii qofaan fayyadamuuf karaa Yerusaalemii fi qubannaa Ma’ale Adumim gidduutti ijaaruuf qophoofteetti. Hojiin kun kutaalee daldalaa warra Falasxiin diiguu fi namoota 4,000 ol ta'an iddoo jireenya isaanii irraa buqqisuu kan qabuudha. Karoorri kun yoo raawwatame, lafa Lixaa (West Bank) bakka lamatti hiruu fi qubannaa haaraa warra Israa'el ijaaruuf carraa uuma.

title: Yemen's Houthis accuse Saudi Arabia of air raids, missile strikes
english: Houthi forces in Yemen have blamed Saudi Arabia for conducting a series of airstrikes across the nation, including a fatal attack on a prison. The group stated that seven people, including a child, died during the bombing in Al-Hazm. These hostilities occur as the Houthis continue their military campaign to gain control over territory near the strategic Bab el-Mandab Strait.
amharic: የየመኑ ሁቲ አማጺያን በሀገሪቱ የተለያዩ አካባቢዎች ላይ ሳውዲ አረቢያ የአየር ድብደባ ማድረሷን ከሰዋል። ቡድኑ አል-ሃዝም በተባለ ስፍራ በሚገኝ እስር ቤት ላይ በተፈጸመ ጥቃት አንድ ህጻንን ጨምሮ ሰባት ሰዎች መሞታቸውን አስታውቋል። እነዚህ ጥቃቶች የተፈጸሙት ሁቲዎች በባቢ አል-ማንዳብ ባህረ-ሰላጤ አቅራቢያ የሚገኝ መሬት ለመቆጣጠር በሚያደርጉት ወታደራዊ ዘመቻ ወቅት ነው።
oromo: Humni Huutii kan Yaman keessatti argamu, Saudii Arabiyaan bakkeewwan garagaraa irratti haleellaa qilleensa irraa raawwachuu ishee himateera. Haleellaa mana hidhaa Al-Hazm irratti raawwatameen ijoollee dabalatee namoonni torba ajjeefamuun gabaafameera. Haleellaan kun kan raawwatame yeroo loltoonni Huutii bakkeewwan dhiyaata Bab el-Mandab jiran to'achuuf duula waraanaa gaggeessaa jiranitti.

title: Macklemore calls for a ‘free Palestine’ during Ed Sheeran shows, prompting praise and backlash
english: American rapper Macklemore faced both criticism and support after performing his pro-Palestine song 'Hind's Hall' during Ed Sheeran's concerts in New Jersey. During the performances, he displayed images from Gaza and the West Bank to thousands of fans to highlight his stance against the ongoing conflict. While pro-Israel groups pressured him, many activists and social media users have rallied behind the artist for using his platform to voice his political views.
amharic: አሜሪካዊው ራፐር ማክለሞር በኤድ ሽራን ኮንሰርት ወቅት 'ሂንድስ ሆል' የተሰኘውን የፍልስጤም ደጋፊ ዘፈኑን በማቅረቡ የተለያዩ አስተያየቶችን አስተናግዷል። በኒው ጀርሲ በተካሄደው ትርኢት ላይ በጋዛ እና በዌስት ባንክ ያለውን ሁኔታ የሚያሳዩ ምስሎችን ለተመልካቾች በማሳየት ተቃውሞውን ገልጿል። ምንም እንኳን በኢስራኤል ደጋፊ ቡድኖች ዘንድ ግፊት ቢደርስበትም፣ ብዙ የሰብአዊ መብት ተሟጋቾች እና አድናቂዎች ለወሰደው አቋም ድጋፋቸውን ሰጥተውታል።
oromo: Raapperiin Ameerikaa Maaklemor sirba isaa kan waa'ee Palastinoonni deggaru 'Hind's Hall' jedhu konsertii Ed Shiiranirratti dhiheessuu isaatiin walqabatee yaada garaagaraa ofirratti harkiseera. Niiwu Jersiitti sirba isaa dhiheessaa ture irratti, haala Ghaazaafi Qomoo Lixaa keessa jiru mul'isuudhaan yaada isaa ifatti ibseera. Gareewwan Israa'el deggaran isa irratti dhiibbaa godhanis, namoonni mirga namoomaa falman hedduufi deggaroonni isaa yaada isaa ifatti ibsachuu isaatiif isa jajaniiru.

title: Palestinian child killed by Israel on first day back at school in Gaza
english: Eight-year-old Palestinian girl Wafaa Akila and her father were killed in an Israeli drone strike in Gaza City on Sunday. The attack occurred while they were traveling shortly after the child finished her first day of the new school year. While the Israeli military claimed the father was a Hamas militant, the incident has sparked widespread outrage over the ongoing civilian casualties in the region.
amharic: የስምንት ዓመቷ ፍልስጤማዊት ህጻን ወፋ አኪላ እና አባቷ በእሁድ እለት በጋዛ ከተማ በተፈጸመ የእስራኤል የድሮን ጥቃት ተገደሉ። ጥቃቱ የተፈጸመው ህጻኗ አዲሱን የትምህርት ዘመን የጀመረችበትን የመጀመሪያ ቀን ትምህርት ቤት አጠናቃ ወደ ቤት እየተመለሱ በነበረበት ወቅት ነው። የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ክፍል አባቷን የሀማስ ታጣቂ ነው ብሎ ቢከስም፣ በሲቪል ህዝቡ ላይ እየደረሰ ያለው ተደጋጋሚ ሞት ከፍተኛ ቁጣን ቀስቅሷል።
oromo: Intalti umriin ishee waggaa saddeet ta'e, Wafaa Akiilaa fi abbaan ishee Dilbata darbe magaalaa Gaazaa keessatti xiyyaara raajii (drone) Israa'eliin ajjeefaman. Miidhaan kun kan mudate, ijoolleen sun guyyaa barnootaa ishee jalqabaa erga xumurte booda abbaa ishee wajjin osoo imalaa jirtuudha. Waraanni Israa'el abbaan ishee miseensa garee Hamaas ture jedhee himatus, ajjeechaan kun du'a nagaa bu'otaa itti fufaa jiru irratti dheekkamsa guddaa uumeera.

title: Report: US official says Hormuz fully open, under US control
english: A United States official confirmed that the Strait of Hormuz is now completely accessible and monitored by the US Navy. This status was achieved following a secret mission to clear mines that began in the spring. Authorities anticipate that commercial vessel traffic will rise, noting that current energy supplies moving through the region remain stable.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ባለስልጣናት እንደገለጹት የሆርሙዝ ስትሬት አሁን ሙሉ በሙሉ ክፍት እና በአሜሪካ የባህር ኃይል ቁጥጥር ስር ነው። ይህ የተገኘው ከአፕሪል ወር ጀምሮ በተካሄደው ሚስጥራዊ የማዕድን ማጽጃ ዘመቻ ነው። በዚህም የተነሳ በስፍራው የሚደረገው የንግድ መርከቦች እንቅስቃሴ እንደሚጨምር እና የነዳጅ አቅርቦቱም የተረጋጋ መሆኑን ተጠቁሟል።
oromo: Hoji-gaggeessitoonni Ameerikaa akka ibsanitti, daandiin galaana Hormuz yeroo ammaa guutummaatti banamee fi to'annoo galaana Ameerikaa jala jira. Haalli kun kan mirkanaa'e erga ji'a Epreelii jalqabee hojii miinara lafa keessa jiru of eeggannoon qulqulleessuu erga gaggeeffamee booda. Kanaan walqabatee, imalli dooniiwwan daldalaa dabaluun kan eegamu yoo ta'u, dhiyeessiin boba'aa naannichaan darbu akka gaariitti akka jiru ibsameera.

title: US presence in Gulf 'not enough' for security, Qatari official says
english: A Qatari official has stated that relying solely on US military presence is no longer sufficient for Gulf security, urging regional nations to prioritize self-sufficiency. While acknowledging the importance of strategic alliances, the spokesperson emphasized the need to build a stable, long-term relationship with neighboring Iran. This shift in perspective follows increased tensions and Iranian retaliatory actions that have impacted US assets throughout the region.
amharic: የኳታር የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስቴር ቃል አቀባይ የአሜሪካ ጦር በባህረ ሰላጤው አካባቢ መኖር ብቻ ለክልሉ ደህንነት በቂ እንዳልሆነ ገለጹ። ሀገራት በውጭ አጋሮች ላይ ብቻ ከመደገፍ ይልቅ የራሳቸውን የመከላከል አቅም ማጠናከር እንዳለባቸው አስገንዝበዋል። ከዚህም በላይ፣ ከአጎራባችዋ ኢራን ጋር ዘላቂ ሰላም ለመፍጠር መሥራት እንደሚያስፈልግ የጠቆሙ ሲሆን፣ ይህ አቋም የመጣው በክልሉ በተቀሰቀሰው ውጥረት እና በተደጋጋሚ ጥቃቶች ምክንያት ነው።
oromo: Hoggantoonni Qatar akka ibsanitti, humnoonni Ameerikaa naannicha keessa jiraachuun qofti nageenya naannoo Goolfii eeguuf gahaa miti. Biyyoonni naannichaa gargaarsa alaa irratti qofa hirkachuu dhiisanii, nageenya isaanii of danda'anii eeggachuu akka qaban dhaamaniiru. Kana malees, ollaa isaanii kan taate Iran wajjin walitti dhufeenya gaarii uumuun akka barbaachisu ibsanii, kunis walitti bu'iinsa naannichatti uumamee fi miidhaa ga'een booda murteessaa ta'uu dubbataniiru.

title: Grindr to pay £26m to settle claims it allegedly shared users' HIV status
english: The dating app Grindr has agreed to pay £26 million to settle a lawsuit involving over 11,000 users who claimed their private information, including HIV status, was shared with third parties without consent. These claims relate to data practices that occurred before 2020, and the company has chosen to settle without admitting any legal liability. The compensation will be paid in two equal installments, with the firm acknowledging the loss of trust experienced by its users during that period.
amharic: የፍቅር ጓደኝነት መተግበሪያ የሆነው ግሪንድር (Grindr) የተጠቃሚዎቹን የግል መረጃ፣ የኤችአይቪ ሁኔታን ጨምሮ፣ ያለ ፈቃዳቸው ለሶስተኛ ወገኖች አጋርቷል ተብሎ የቀረበበትን ክስ ለመፍታት 26 ሚሊዮን ፓውንድ ለመክፈል ተስማምቷል። ከ11,000 በላይ ተጠቃሚዎች በተሳተፉበት በዚህ የክስ ሂደት፣ ድርጅቱ ጥፋቱን ሳይቀበል ክፍያውን ለመፈጸም ወስኗል። ይህ ክስ የሚያተኩረው ከ2020 በፊት በነበሩ አሠራሮች ላይ ሲሆን፣ ድርጅቱ ለተጠቃሚዎቹ የደረሰውን የትረስት መጓደል እንደሚረዳ ገልጿል።
oromo: Appiin wal-qunnamtii Grindr jedhamu, odeeffannoo dhuunfaa fayyadamtootaa, kanneen akka haala fayyaa HIV dabalatee, hayyama malee gara qaama sadaffaatti dabarseera jedhamee himatamee ture. Himata kana furuufis qarshii milioona 26 kaffaluuf walii galeera. Himanni kun kan irratti xiyyeeffatu baroota 2020 dura ture, dhaabbatichis yeroo sana rakkoo amanannaa uumame beekamtii kenneera. Kafaltiin kunis himata irratti argamuu hin mirkaneessu yoo ta'u, kaffaltiin kunis bakka lamatti qoodamee kan raawwatamu ta'a.

title: Convicted war criminal Ratko Mladic gets hero’s burial in Serbia
english: Ratko Mladic, the former Bosnian Serb general convicted of genocide and war crimes, was recently buried in Belgrade with full military honors. Thousands of supporters and government officials attended the event, which drew widespread international criticism for glorifying a convicted war criminal. High-ranking European officials condemned the ceremony, arguing that such actions contradict the values required for regional peace and reconciliation.
amharic: በዘር ማጥፋት እና በጦር ወንጀል የተፈረደበት የቦስኒያ ሰርብ ጄኔራል የነበረው ራትኮ ምላዲች በቤልግሬድ በወታደራዊ ክብር ተቀብሯል። የቀብር ሥነ ሥርዓቱ በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ደጋፊዎች እና የመንግስት ባለስልጣናት በተገኙበት የተከናወነ ሲሆን፣ ድርጊቱ ወንጀለኛን የሚያሞካሽ ነው በሚል በዓለም አቀፍ ደረጃ ከፍተኛ ትችት አስነስቷል። ከፍተኛ የአውሮፓ ህብረት ባለስልጣናት የቀብር ስነስርዓቱን በመቃወም፣ እንዲህ አይነት ድርጊቶች ለቀጠናው ሰላም እና ዕርቅ የሚጠየቁትን መርሆዎች የሚጻረሩ መሆናቸውን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Ajajaa waraanaa duraanii kan Boosniyaa Serb Ratko Mlaadich, kan yakka sanyii lafarraa balleessuu fi yakka waraanaatiin murteeffame, magaalaa Beligireeditti kabaja waraanaatiin awwaallameera. Sirna awwaallaa kana irratti namoonni kumaatamaan lakkaawaman fi bakka buutonni mootummaa kan argaman yoo ta'u, gochi kun yakka waraanaa raawwate tokko faarsuudha jechuun mormiin guddaan addunyaa irraa isatti dhufeera. Hoggantoonni Awurooppaa sirnicha balaaleffachuun, gochi akkasii kun nagaa fi araara naannichaa fiduuf faallaa kan dhaabatu ta'uu ibsaniiru.
